Definition: a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine-vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed)
BiblicalUsage: The word yeqeb is the Bible's way of saying a winepress, a wine-vat. In Numbers 18:27, as the fulness of the winepress, and it appears again in Deuteronomy 15:14.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe yeqeb still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
